desc:
Fix up an old roadside motel and turn it into the best stop on the road!

Clean the rooms, make the beds and check in your guests at the front desk. Every happy guest pays, tips and leaves a review. More stars bring more guests.

WHAT YOU DO
- Clean rooms with a vacuum and a mop
- Wash the sheets and make the beds
- Hand out room keys and carry suitcases
- Make coffee and answer room service calls
- Furnish every room: beds, lamps, sofas, tubs and more
- Grow rooms from Regular to Comfort to VIP
- Clean up the yard, wash off graffiti and fix the neon sign
- Open the pool and renovate the second floor
- Hire staff to help you run the motel

Meet truckers, rock stars, families, newlyweds and even a hotel inspector. Some guests want a special corner, some bring a pet.

New updates are coming. Favorite the game so you don't miss them!
